What is a Spin Wheel?

A Spin Wheel is a customizable random selection tool that lets you create a wheel with any options you want. Just add your choices, give it a spin, and let fate decide. Perfect for making decisions fun and fair—whether you're picking a restaurant, choosing a game, or settling any debate.

When to Use the Spin Wheel

  • • Group decisions where everyone wants a fair chance
  • • Choosing from multiple options without bias
  • • Making boring decisions more exciting
  • • Deciding who goes first in games or activities
  • • Random selection for contests or giveaways

Pros

  • ✓ Fully customizable with your own options
  • ✓ Visual excitement makes decisions fun
  • ✓ Fair and transparent selection process
  • ✓ Works great for groups and parties
  • ✓ Save and share your wheel configurations

Considerations

  • • Results are random, not based on logic
  • • Best for low-stakes decisions
  • • May need to re-spin if same result repeats
  • • Works best with 3-12 options for visual clarity

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I create a custom wheel?

Type your option in the input field and click "Add" or press Enter. You can add as many options as you like. Each option will appear as a colored segment on the wheel.

Can I edit options after creating the wheel?

Yes! Click on any option text in the list to edit it. Changes will be reflected on the wheel immediately. You can also delete options by clicking the trash icon.

How fair is the spin?

The wheel uses a random spin animation that makes it difficult to predict the outcome. The final result is determined by where the wheel stops, which is influenced by the initial spin force and physics.

Let the wheel guide your decisions

Use the Spin Wheel to Teach Decision-Making

The Spin Wheel isn't just for decisions—it's a tool for teaching kids how to make choices. Let them add their own options, discuss why they chose them, and see what happens when choice is made for them. This builds flexibility, reduces decision fatigue, and makes the process less personal. When the wheel decides, it's not Mom's fault or Dad's preference—it's just chance. That's a valuable lesson in letting go of control.
